recap.text: Donut reads the Puddle Jumper spell book from her Bronze Boss Box while Carl sticks with human. Mordecai says it carries her and up to three others for twenty mana, with a five-hour cooldown. Carl stays behind because of his extra fairy aggro, so Donut spends 20 of her 26 points and vanishes with a wet pop. She reappears between the two laminak fairies as the clurichauns jump to their feet.

beats.headline: Read before the description
beats.text: Donut's Bronze Boss Box has given her yet another spell book, and she hasn't read it yet. She announces she was born a cat and will die a cat, and that Carl must choose a cat race too; when he says he is sticking with human, she does her approximation of a shrug and glows as she reads the tome. Did she at least read the description? Mordecai nods. Puddle Jumper, a good one: herself and up to three others, anywhere in her line of sight, further at higher levels, almost as good as Teleport at level 15. Twenty mana, a ten-second delay, a five-hour cooldown.
beats.gist: Donut reads her new spell book, Puddle Jumper, which teleports her and up to three others within sight.

beats.headline: A wet pop between fairies
beats.text: The two biggest problems with Puddle Jumper are the cooldown and the mana. Once Donut is in that room she cannot teleport out for five hours, and the spell costs 20 of her 26 points. Carl stays behind; with his extra fairy aggro, nobody knows what would happen if they both showed themselves. Donut casts it, fades through the ten-second countdown and vanishes with a loud, wet pop, reappearing at the far end of the room right between the two laminak fairies as the clurichauns jump to their feet.
beats.gist: Donut casts Puddle Jumper, spending 20 of her 26 points, and pops in between the two fairies.
